content: LLM document generation apps converge on a pipeline architecture: intake, planning or analysis stage emitting structured JSON, per-section generation with shared context, schema validation, human-in-the-loop review checkpoints, then assembly and export. Structured output JSON schema is the contract between stages; streaming structured output lets frontends render sections incrementally. Corroborated across ZenML pipeline guides, Vercel AI SDK patterns, LangGraph agent patterns. MEDIUM confidence (multiple secondary sources agree).
